name: Vault (dev mode)
description: HashiCorp Vault in dev server mode: in-memory, auto-unsealed, for local secrets-management experiments.

source.name: HashiCorp Vault official Docker image documentation
source.license: Business Source License 1.1 (Vault server); documentation used under fair use

notes: Dev mode: unsealed automatically, all data is in memory and lost on restart, TLS is disabled. Never use dev mode for anything beyond local experimentation. Sign in to the UI with the root token as the password (method: Token).
